info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Referrals-v1-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Referral Listing API allows users to access and retrieve information about career applications made through referrals. This endpoint provides detailed insights into the referral applications, enabling businesses to assess the effectiveness of their referral programs. Typical consumers include HR teams and recruitment platforms that need to analyze or manage referral submissions. Use cases often involve reporting on referral success rates and tracking candidate advancements originating from referrals.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of referral applications
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all referral applications submitted, providing a comprehensive view of the current applications under referral. You can use this information for further processing or analysis.
